claims: All nine listed artifact SHA-256 values and the manifest-order composite independently match the frozen manifest.

The current literal profiles and all emitted blind inputs keep the final consequential call human-owned: the four families name leader-owned gates and the builder emits R1 Explore authority with consequential recommendation, durable-truth promotion and named-employee evaluation disabled.

The implemented gate can nevertheless falsely pass an AGENCY-RANGE-01 violation. The profile validator accepts any non-empty humanDecisionBoundary and checks routeChangingQuestion only for one question mark, a 24-word ceiling and a narrow jargon list. The main oracle is not exact-bound in the way the lifecycle oracle is.

The emitted task is an unconstrained string and no blind-input validator or direct-gate assertion exact-binds its agency instruction. A task that tells the model to recommend a rollout or judge a named employee can therefore compile while the existing deterministic checks remain green.

The negative suites check boundary presence, safe flags on current outputs and five abstraction-heavy questions, but do not require rejection of AI-owned purpose, standards, exceptions, final calls, rubber-stamp framing or named-person employment judgement. Under the frozen brief, this false-pass path is a failure.

veto.failure: Agency-invalid prompt and oracle mutations can pass the implemented gate: the validator does not reject a non-empty boundary that assigns purpose, standards, exceptions or the final consequential call to AI, a short question that turns role design into named-person employment judgement, or a blind-input task that instructs consequential recommendation. This permits a green validator while the leader is reduced to a rubber stamp.
